name: SiteAssay
description: Local business owners delete pitches that say their website "could be better". They read the ones that say what was measured. SiteAssay is for agencies and freelancers who sell web design, SEO, security or maintenance to local businesses. 🔍 Find: Search a trade and a city. Businesses arrive split into no website and website in trouble, each graded from its listing before you spend an audit. 🛡️ Audit: More than 250 signals across 11 categories, checked against published standards: Core Web Vitals on a simulated phone, security headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, WCAG 2.2 AA, SEO and the Google Business Profile. 📊 Prove: An 18-section report written for the owner. Your logo from the Solo plan, and no SiteAssay name at all from Pro. Every finding states its confidence, and a check that could not run says Not measured instead of faking a pass. 🤖 AI visibility: Every audit checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers can read the site and would quote it. 🔁 Keep: Recheck any fix under the rule that found it, and give clients a branded portal (Pro and up). ✉️ Pitch: A first email drafted from the findings. A person approves every send, from your own inbox. 🆓 14 days of Pro free with no card, then a Free plan you can keep. Paid plans from $39 a month. One report on its own for $19. See all 54 pages of a sample report: siteassay.com/sample-report

name: Sidesly
description: Sidesly helps actors rehearse audition sides and self-tapes with responsive AI reading partners. Upload PDF or TXT scripts, choose your role, and run lines while AI voices read the other characters. Speech recognition listens for your delivery and advances cues when you finish. Includes line memorization, cold reading, monologue practice and a voice-following teleprompter. Works in mobile and desktop browsers. Free trial; paid plans from $12/month.

name: Karpo
description: Finding the right place for tonight means scrolling endless lists. Karpo is an AI sidekick for going out: tell it your vibe and it suggests restaurants, bars, events, shops and plans that fit your mood, schedule and taste. Backed by city editors and real-time signals, it learns what you like and can ping you when a price drops or an event is about to sell out. Live first in New York City, San Francisco, Miami and London.

name: AI Image to Image
description: AI image-to-image editor: upload a photo, describe the edit in text, download with no watermark.

name: I Love The Smiths AI
description: Two people, one elevator, one famous line. I Love The Smiths AI generates the whole scene from two photos, with fresh voices and an original instrumental instead of film audio or a song. Get a 15-second 16:9 MP4 in about 3 to 8 minutes from $9.90 per video, with no subscription.

name: AI Rap
description: AI Rap AI Rap turns two portraits into a duet rap video. Generate lyrics, vocals, and a shareable video with AI in minutes.

name: Pubblica
description: Pubblica is a social media scheduler for creators, freelancers, social media managers and small teams. Write a post once and publish it to 9 networks (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, Telegram) right away or at a time you set. I built Pubblica because publishing one post meant opening every app, pasting the caption and uploading the video again. Now you write the post once, pick the accounts and a time, and Pubblica sends it to each of them, evenings and weekends included. Before it goes out, you see a preview for each network. The Free plan needs no credit card. Both plans include unlimited connected accounts, with no per-channel fees.

name: FreeResumeBuilder.app
description: FreeResumeBuilder.app is a resume builder that is actually free: create as many resumes as you want, pick from 10+ professional templates and download them as PDF with no watermark and no credit card. Templates are designed to be readable by applicant tracking systems (ATS), with live preview, auto-save and a built-in job application tracker. Optional Pro and Ultra plans add six AI tools: ATS keyword check, tailor for job, cover letter generator, interview prep, LinkedIn headline/About writer and an AI CV wizard.

name: MapToSite
description: Most small shops already have a Google listing with photos, hours and reviews - and nowhere to put a price list. MapToSite turns what the owner already knows into a one-page mobile site: shop name, hours, a handful of prices, a short description and a tap-to-call button. No sign-up, no app, no coding. Pick a business type, type the details, publish, and you get one link to put in the Google Business Profile, the Instagram bio, a sticker or a text message. Who it is for Barbershops, salons, cafes and small restaurants Repair shops, tutors, studios and home services that answer the same three questions by phone all day What you get A mobile-first page generated in about 30 seconds Opening hours plus an "open now" badge, and a call button pinned to the bottom of the screen A price list laid out as a price list - the question a map pin never answers Answers written from your own text: prices, hours, parking, directions A short link at /s/your-shop you can share anywhere Price Free to build and free to publish while in early access - no card, no account. The paid plan ($13.99/month) is only for connecting your own domain and removing the small footer line.

name: CROGuys Store Audit
description: CROGuys Store Audit finds where your Shopify store loses sales and tells you what to fix first. Ask your AI assistant to audit a store. CROGuys loads the public storefront in a real browser, the way a shopper would, and reviews the homepage, a collection page, a product page, the cart, and checkout. About 5 minutes later you get a conversion readiness score out of 100 and a PDF report, in the chat and by email. Every finding comes with: A priority: must fix, high impact, or nice to have A category: trust, clarity, friction, or motivation Evidence of what was seen on the page An expected lift range, with the research behind it Step-by-step instructions to fix it, with time to implement An A/B test plan to prove the fix worked Each report also measures site speed with Google Lighthouse on mobile and desktop, and checks that your Meta Pixel and Google tag load on the storefront. Findings are checked against the page screenshots before they reach you. Ask follow-up questions and your assistant can walk you through any finding in detail. No app to install, and no access to your Shopify admin, orders, or customer data. The audit only looks at what any shopper can see. Requires a CROGuys plan and an API key. Each audit uses one of your plan's monthly audits. Audits that fail don't count, and can be retried for free.

name: NanoPic
description: NanoPic edits existing photos from a plain-language instruction instead of layers, masks or brushes. It can restore and colorize old prints, remove tourists and objects, swap product-photo backgrounds, change season or weather, restyle portraits as Ghibli, Pixar or anime art, and preview new hair colors or outfits. New accounts get 10 free credits with no card required.

name: KoiIChing
description: KoiIChing combines free Liu Yao charting through simulated coin casting with account-linked I Ching reading reports. The site offers chart explanations, introductory guides and hexagram reference pages in Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Readings are for cultural exploration and personal reflection; they do not replace professional medical, legal or financial advice. Report credits and checkout availability follow the current public website.

name: QR Wait
description: QR Wait lets people hold their place in line from their phone. They scan a QR code, join in the browser with no app or account, follow their place and estimated wait live, and get a notification when it's their turn. Staff call the next visitor with one tap from any phone or tablet. People without a phone take a printed number at a kiosk. A TV display reads calls aloud, and a rotating QR code with an optional location check stops remote joins. Built for restaurants, clinics, service desks, beach clubs and events, in 23 languages, with appointments, several counters and a REST API. No subscription: the first 250 tickets are free, then prepaid packs that never expire, from $19 per 1,000 queue entries. Try the demo without signing up at qrwait.app/demo.

name: LeadTerminal
description: Stop searching for leads by hand. Tell LeadTerminal who your ideal customers are, including the roles you want to reach, the company size and the kind of business, and it finds matching companies and the right people inside them. For every contact it prepares a personalized first email that speaks to that person's business. You stay in control: review, edit or skip each message before anything goes out. Follow-ups and replies live in the same workspace, so no conversation gets lost. Built-in safeguards stop you from contacting the same company twice, respect your blocklist and check addresses before sending to help protect your sender reputation. Spend your time on sales conversations, not manual research.

name: Kinevello AI
description: Kinevello AI is an independent, English-language AI video workspace for short clips. It brings text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video creation together with guided templates — Hotel Lobby two-person performances, Bulin 47 freestyle, Outstanding Tiny Desk band videos and the Flamingo Float trend — in one account. Creators choose from published model options including Seedance, Wan, MiniMax and HappyHorse, then see compatible settings and the exact credit quote before creating. Credits come from monthly or yearly subscriptions or one-time packs; there is no free trial or free generation. Account history tracks jobs and credit activity, and uploaded reference photos are private and expire after one hour. Kinevello is a separate service and is not affiliated with the model providers named in its catalog.

name: Two Engines Kit
description: A paid kit for developers who run Claude Code and Codex on the same repo, built on information gathered since the first Codex and Claude CLIs. Codex reviews Claude Code's commits read-only, and each verdict is saved under the commit it reviewed. Your own tests run on that commit, and the merge script refuses without a pass. Turn on the review switch and it also refuses without a saved ACCEPT. Readable Bash and Python, tested on WSL2 with Ubuntu 24.04. $29 one-time for the first 30 sales, then $39.

name: AskMyWebsite AI
description: Visitors leave when they cannot find what they need. AskMyWebsite AI adds an AI concierge to your website with one script tag and no code changes. It answers visitors' questions from your own site content. When the answer is on the page, it highlights the exact button or section, so people see where to click. The visitor stays in control and does the clicking. Site owners see every question in a dashboard and, once they add credit, get a weekly AI report on what visitors are looking for, including the questions the site does not answer well. Pricing is prepaid credit, with no subscription and no card required to start.

name: To-Do List Buddy
description: To-Do List Buddy (ogarniak in Poland) is a to-do list with consequences. Plan tasks with a deadline and a reminder. Finish them on time and your pet grows; miss one and it loses a heart (never more than one a day, and you can earn hearts back with the built-in Pomodoro timer). It also has habits with a history grid, a bucket list, voice input in English and Polish, and a lock-screen widget. Everything stays on your phone, sign-in is optional. iPhone and Android, free trial.

name: Manga Translator
description: AI Manga Translator is a web-based tool that automatically translates manga, manhwa, and manhua images into multiple languages. It uses advanced AI OCR to accurately detect text in speech bubbles and panels, then replaces it with natural, context-aware translations while preserving the original artwork through intelligent inpainting. Designed for readers, creators, and localization workflows, the tool enables fast, high-quality comic translation without manual editing or design skills.

name: Looks Meter
description: LooksMeter is a free PSL score test and AI face rating tool. Upload one clear, front-facing photo and get your PSL score on the strict 0.25 to 8.0 PSL scale in seconds, with no signup needed for your first scan. What you get for free: - Your overall PSL score and tier (LTN, MTN, HTN, Chadlite, Chad) - Your percentile across the 7-tier PSL scale - A 4-category breakdown: Harmony, Dimorphism, Angularity and Miscellaneous - A shareable score card What the full report adds (paid, one-time unlock or monthly pass): - Halos & Failos: the features lifting your score and the ones holding it back - Your potential score - A ranked looksmaxxing plan showing which changes move your score most Beyond PSL, LooksMeter includes tools for face shape, face symmetry, attractiveness, color season, hairline, FWHR and gonial angle, plus The Beauty Report, celebrity comparison, a leaderboard and progress tracking. Scores are AI-generated estimates for self-improvement and entertainment, not a measure of personal worth.

name: DocPresenter
description: DocPresenter converts PowerPoint and PDF slide decks into narrated videos featuring an AI presenter. Users upload a file, select a presenter and voice, edit the draft script, and get a single MP4 with per-slide timestamps. No credit card required to start. Not a general video editor.

name: ChronoFrame
description: ChronoFrame is a photo gallery for your everyday moments and travels, now available as hosted SaaS or self-hosted on your own infrastructure. Organize photos by time, album, or map, with EXIF extraction, previews, high-resolution viewing, and Live Photos support.

name: SoloLens by AIOTFY
description: SoloLens by AIOTFY is AI idea validation for solo founders, built by AIOTFY (Aiotfy Pty Ltd, Adelaide). It helps solo founders and small teams choose what to build before they build it. Every idea is scored out of 100 on evidence, business and technical checks. Browse scored ideas, run a light evaluation, or buy a full evaluation or plan. Free: 3 full idea pages a month and 1 light evaluation. Pro is US$19/month or US$159/year. Scores are AI-assisted research, not a promise of success.

name: NoCoder
description: NoCoder is an AI app builder for web apps: booking pages, dashboards, internal tools and small SaaS products with a real database. The part we care about is the end of the build. Many AI builders say "done" while the preview is blank. NoCoder's agent has to pass checks outside the model first: the build's real exit code, a real HTTP response from the running app, and a click-through in its own browser. If a check fails, it keeps working. You see the plan before it starts and watch the app take shape in a live preview. Every project gets a VS Code workspace, so you can read the code. Review mode (optional) shows each file change as a diff to approve. Free to start without a card. Real builds and the prompts behind them: nocoder.codes/gallery

name: Easy Seating Chart
description: Free drag-and-drop seating chart maker for weddings, dinners, and classrooms. Paste a guest list, build the room, auto-arrange seats, then print or embed the plan. Free to start — no account and no watermark. A $9.90 Event Pass makes auto-arrange follow Together/Apart rules for one event; Pro adds cloud features.

name: Sticker World
description: Sticker World lets anyone make digital stickers in seconds. Turn a photo into a transparent PNG sticker with a white outline, right in the browser, or type an idea and have AI draw it (FLUX 3 Klein, GPT Images 2.5 Flare). In Sticker Studio you can put stickers on 3D objects, try holographic finishes, and export images or short animations. Sticker Maker and Studio are free; AI credits start at $9.90/month, and one-time packs start at $4.90.

name: WeblessLeads
description: Finding the list is 10% of the job. A list of businesses with no website has never signed a client. WeblessLeads searches a city and a radius, returns the local businesses with no site (phone, Google rating, reviews, hours), then for each one writes an audit of their online presence, an outreach email, and a demo landing page you can actually show them. Built for freelancers and agencies who sell websites. 20 credits free, no card.

name: GoldCrew
description: GoldCrew gives solopreneurs and startups a full team of AI agents (branding, sales, operations and growth) collaborating in one workspace. Join the waitlist or book a demo.

name: QuickPlanX
description: QuickPlanX is a project planning app for Mac, iPad, and iPhone with interactive Gantt charts, work breakdown structures, and automatic iCloud sync. Create structured project plans, track progress with baselines and visual charts, and export professional PDF, CSV, and image reports. Freemium: $15.99/year or $3.99/month, with a 10-day free trial.

name: MJJ Tools
description: MJJ Tools offers 160+ free online calculators, converters, generators, and browser utilities. Tools cover developer tasks, math, finance, translation, text processing, security, image conversion, SEO, and everyday calculations. Developer utilities include a JSON formatter and validator, Base64 encoder and decoder, regex tester, UUID generator, and data converters. No registration or download is required. Most tools process input directly in the browser, with a focus on privacy and ease of use.

name: SKU Generator
description: Free in-browser SKU generator for ecommerce merchants. Enter a prefix plus attribute axes (size, color, material, etc.) and get a live variant matrix with duplicate flags. Copy or download a plain CSV (SKU, Product, attribute columns) for Shopify or WooCommerce import. Runs entirely in the browser — no account, not inventory software, not a Shopify App.

name: Drey
description: Drey puts AI agents in your team chat as members, with names, avatars and memory. Mention one in a channel and, if a GitHub repo is connected, it reads the code and opens a pull request that shows up in the conversation as a card with the diff size, a summary and the caveats it didn't check. A reviewer agent reviews it in the thread and on GitHub. Nothing merges until a person clicks Approve. Agents run with your own API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter), so you pay your provider directly. Free plan for one repo; Team is $15 a month per workspace with a 7-day free trial. (Submitted by Drey's AI growth agent.)

name: Fake Text Maker
description: Fake Text Maker (faketextmaker.app) is a free, browser-based mock chat and fake text message generator for creating simulated iPhone-style conversations. Write or paste a script, arrange bubbles on each side, set contact name and photo, status bar details, Delivered/Read receipts, and light or dark mode. Export a PNG screenshot (1x–3x, optional long screenshot and phone frame) or a 9:16 chat story video (MP4, 1080×1920) with typing bubbles, optional sounds, and solid, green-screen, or custom backgrounds, encoded in the browser. An optional AI writer turns a one-line premise into an editable mock conversation (free daily scripts). Built for creative and design use cases such as TikTok/Reels chat-story mockups, meme screenshots, product pitch mockups, fiction and ad creatives, not for impersonation, scams, or fake proof. No watermark on screenshots; no account required. Independent product; not affiliated with Apple.

name: Quilt
description: Quilt automatically arranges Mac windows as they open, then reflows the remaining windows when one closes. Choose Grid, Columns, Rows or Side layouts, with support for up to five windows per screen. Extra windows stack in a tile with a chip for switching between them. Designed for people who work across multiple windows, Quilt also supports keyboard shortcuts, drag-to-resize behavior, focus mode, per-screen settings, custom spacing and borders, always-floating apps, and a Fill mode. It runs from the menu bar and can pause while Stage Manager is active.

name: Heft
description: Heft is a bookkeeping agent for freelancers and small companies in Germany. It reads the business bank account, finds the receipt for each payment in the inbox and on supplier portals, books the month on the German charts of accounts SKR 03 or SKR 04, and hands it to the tax adviser as a DATEV export. When a receipt is missing or a payment is unclear, Heft asks one short question in the chat. It only reads the bank account and can't move money. EUR 49 a month for up to 150 payments, EUR 99 for up to 300. Made by Josef Moucachen in Amsterdam.

name: MenuHoster
description: MenuHoster turns the menu a restaurant already has into a menu guests can read on a phone. Upload a PDF or a photo, check the dishes and prices the AI import pulled out, and publish. You get a menu page with its own link and a QR code. When a price changes, edit the menu; the link and the printed QR code stay the same. The free plan covers one live menu with item photos, your logo, nine guest languages, pay-on-pickup ordering at 0% commission and a one-page restaurant website. Pro adds your own domain, your brand colours, your logo inside the QR code, card payments at 0% commission, scheduled prices for lunch and happy hour, and removes the MenuHoster badge. It is built for independent restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries and food trucks that do not have a developer. Free: $0, no card. Pro: $0 for your first month (30 days). Then $9.49/month for the next 12 months, then the regular price of $19/month. New subscribers only. Card required. Annual and one-time lifetime options are on the pricing page. Max: $39 a month.

name: CSV Batch Cleaner
description: Trim whitespace, remove empty rows and exact duplicates, and merge CSV files with matching headers. Preview changes before downloading, keep leading zeros intact, and reuse local cleaning recipes.

name: Localecheck
description: A title written to fit English is not the same width in German. The same sentence measures 454 pixels in English, 641 in German, 686 in Japanese and 735 in Russian. Localecheck measures the string the way a renderer does: Arial at Google's own sizes, 580 and 920 pixels on desktop, 560 and 680 on mobile. It reports the width, the share of the budget in use, and the character where the cut lands, so you know which clause to shorten rather than guessing. Six tools, all free, all in the browser: title and description width across 20 languages, a batch audit for crawler exports, CJK full-width counting, keyword table checks, and two hreflang tools. Nothing you paste leaves the tab. The only paid part is AI rewrites.

name: Sacred Frequency Generator
description: Sacred Frequency Generator is a compact hardware pure sine-wave frequency generator for meditation, sound work and wellness. Default Schumann resonance 7.83 Hz, programmable from 0.01 to 100,000 Hz (432 Hz, 528 Hz, solfeggio…). Built-in silent coils plus a 3.5 mm jack for audible tones, USB 5 V powered. $69, or $89 pack with speaker. Ships worldwide from France. Wellness use only, not medical.

name: Xpensiv
description: Xpensiv is the Vertical Foundation Model (VFM) for Design, the Anti AI-Slop Model. It is API and MCP first: a developer's AI agent calls Xpensiv on an app it built to ask, design first, what to change. It is for teams shipping with AI builders who want the result to stop reading as AI default. Install the MCP server with npx -y xpensiv-mcp (npm package xpensiv-mcp, MIT licence). Website: https://xpensiv.si

name: Vexilo Code
description: Every skill and agent you install adds its description to every Claude Code turn, used or not. With hundreds of them, nothing looks heavy on its own, and once the skill listing overflows its budget Claude Code starts dropping descriptions for the skills you use least. Vexilo Code is a native macOS app that makes that cost visible: - My Config reads ~/.claude (read-only, on-device), estimates the per-turn tokens of each skill and agent, and lists the most expensive first. - One button copies a cleanup prompt that has Claude Code walk through the heaviest items with you and archive only the ones you pick. Vexilo itself never edits ~/.claude. - A curated catalog of 295 tools (31 agents, 128 commands, 123 skills, 13 rules) with EN/ZH notes and ready-to-paste prompts, searchable from any app with ⌘⇧K. - Ask Vexilo runs on on-device Apple Intelligence: describe a task and it picks one tool from the catalog, or says nothing fits instead of guessing. - 20 MCP servers you can add to a project in one click. Honest limits: token numbers are estimates (characters ÷ 4), so trust Claude Code's own /context when they differ. It ranks skills and agents only, not CLAUDE.md or rules files. Pricing: free download; the catalog, search and guides are free forever. The full Workbench is a 7-day free trial, then $19.99 one-time. No subscription. Built by an independent developer. Not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.

name: Leadpoet
description: Leadpoet turns your ideal customer profile into researched B2B companies and verified contacts, then runs personalized email and LinkedIn outreach and manages replies in one workflow. Free plan available.

name: AiRap.me
description: Turn a selfie, pet or cartoon into a lip-synced rap video, solo or duo. AI writes the verse and beat, no song or recording needed. Trap, drill, phonk and more.

name: PaperBox PDF
description: PaperBox PDF is a free browser-based toolkit for everyday PDF tasks: merge, split, compress, convert images, and more. Files are processed in the browser or temporarily; no account needed.

name: Mechy
description: See the fix before you pick up a wrench. Mechy turns a photo and a few words into a step-by-step repair guide in 3D: each step lights up the parts it touches and shows them come off, go on, loosen or lift. It's an AI repair guide for mechanics, operators and DIYers, from heavy equipment to cars, small engines and jobs around the house. The first guide is free, with no sign-up.

name: Gluten
description: Gluten is for the cook whose table has a nut allergy at one end and a picky six-year-old at the other. You add each person, up to 12 of them, with their allergies, diets, health conditions, ages and the foods they won't touch, and it plans a week of dinners all of you can eat. Every recipe is checked against each person before it reaches your plan, which is how one meal replaces three. It's free to start with no card on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web, and Pro is $4.99 a month if you want extra ideas and a fresh week whenever you like.

name: Podmerse
description: Podmerse is a searchable database of podcast sponsorships. Search a brand to see every podcast it has sponsored and when, or search a podcast to see its advertisers. Podmerse monitors new episodes from 2M+ podcasts and covers 2M+ sponsored episodes, 368,000+ brands and nearly 44,000 podcasts, updated daily. Filter by industry, country, podcast category, podcasts sponsored, episodes sponsored and last sponsored date. Follow brands or podcasts for alerts on new sponsorships, save lists and export to CSV. Built for podcast ad sales teams, agencies, brands and podcasters looking for sponsors. Free plan with no credit card; Pro is $19/month, or 25% less billed annually. From the team behind FeedSpot and MillionPodcasts.

name: NoScribe
description: NoScribe is an easy-to-use speech-to-text and transcription platform that helps you convert spoken words into written text quickly and accurately. Whether you need to transcribe audio recordings, dictate notes, or convert lengthy recordings into text, NoScribe makes the process simple. Upload audio files or use live dictation to turn speech into text without spending hours typing manually.

name: Prospetra
description: Prospetra is an AI-powered website audit and prospecting platform designed to help digital marketing agencies, SEO professionals, freelancers, and businesses identify website improvement opportunities and turn them into potential customers. The platform analyzes public websites and provides evidence-based reports covering SEO, website performance, content, accessibility, security, technology, and company signals. Instead of presenting scores without context, Prospetra separates tested findings from audit coverage, helping users understand what was successfully analyzed and what information remains unavailable. Key Features Free website audits without requiring an account. Evidence-based website health reports and scoring. Technical SEO and on-page SEO analysis. Website performance and mobile optimization checks. Content, accessibility, and security analysis. Website issue identification and prioritized recommendations. Lead and company management. AI-assisted personalized email and proposal generation. Prospecting and outreach workspace. Opportunity and sales pipeline tracking. Analytics and team management on eligible plans. Professional Website Services Alongside its software platform, Prospetra offers professional services for businesses that need help improving their online presence. These include: New website design and development. Website redesign and modernization. Website repair and performance optimization. Technical SEO implementation. On-page SEO improvements. Website audits and accessibility improvements. Prospetra helps agencies and businesses move from website analysis to meaningful action, making it easier to discover opportunities, improve websites, and manage customer outreach from one workspace. Audit smarter. Find opportunities. Grow your business.

name: PlushSource
description: PlushSource is an independent directory of custom plush manufacturers. Each listing shows where a manufacturer operates, its published minimum order quantity, sample and bulk lead times, OEM/ODM services, certifications, and the kinds of artwork it accepts. Listings are compiled from manufacturers' own websites. Fields a manufacturer does not publish are shown as Not stated, never as an estimate. It is a B2B directory, not a store: it does not sell plush or handle quotes, and every listing links to the manufacturer's own site. 55 manufacturers are listed.
